stories.title: Auto Retail Sales Hit Record 55.25 Lakh In Festive Season, EV Sales Surge 52.6%: FADA - ACKO Drive
India records highest ever festive auto sales
stories.summary: Automobile retail sales reached a record 55.25 lakh units during the 42-day festive season, according to the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations. Sales grew 2.21 percent year-on-year, despite a high base from last year's tax-led demand surge. Electric vehicle sales surpassed five lakh units for the first time.

stories.title: Festive auto retail hits record 55.25 lakh units
stories.summary: India's automobile retail sales reached 55,25,490 units during the 42-day festive period, marking an all-time high. The Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations reported a 2.21 percent year-on-year growth. Electric vehicles emerged as the primary accelerators, with sales surging 52.62 percent during the season.

stories.title: India festive auto sales reach record high
stories.summary: Retail sales over the 42-day festive period reached 55.25 lakh units, according to the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations. This represents a 2.21 percent increase over the 2025 festive period. More than five lakh of the vehicles sold were electric, despite a slow start for passenger vehicles.

stories.title: India festive auto sales hit record 5.53 million
stories.summary: Automobile retail sales reached 5.53 million units during the 42-day festive season, a 2.2 percent increase over last year. Electric vehicle sales surged 52.62 percent to cross 500,000 units for the first time. Almost one in 10 vehicles sold during the period was electric.

stories.title: Festive auto retail crosses 55.25 lakh units
stories.summary: Retail sales rose 2.21 percent year-on-year to a record 55.25 lakh units during the 42-day festive season, according to the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations. Electric vehicle sales topped five lakh units for the first time in a single festive season. Dealers and manufacturers reported festive cheer.

stories.title: Festive auto sales set new records
stories.summary: India's automobile retail market recorded its highest-ever festive sales in 2026, with 55.25 lakh vehicles sold during the 42-day period. This is a 2.21 percent increase from 54.05 lakh units a year ago. Sales were up 23.95 percent compared to the 2024 festive season.

stories.title: India posts biggest-ever festive vehicle sales as EVs break records - NewsBytes
India's festive auto retail sales rise 2.21% to record 55.25 lakh units despite high base - ET Auto
Hyundai plans two new 7-seater models
stories.summary: Hyundai is developing two 7-seater vehicles for the Indian market. The Neira will be a family-oriented MPV available in electric and internal combustion engine options. The NI1i will be a premium SUV featuring hybrid technology. Both models target different customer segments.

stories.title: JSW Motors lists Jaecoo J5 and iCAR V23
stories.summary: JSW Motors has added the Jaecoo J5 and Chery iCAR V23 to its India website, with launches expected in 2027. The models will be sold under JSW's own brand identity, separate from JSW MG Motor. Minor design changes are expected for the Indian market.

stories.title: JSW Combat SUV revealed
stories.summary: The JSW Combat SUV will debut in India on December 3, 2026. The plug-in hybrid model is inspired by the global-spec Jetour T2 and is expected to be priced around Rs 40 lakh. It will compete with the Toyota Fortuner and other premium SUVs.

stories.title: Hyundai tests hybrid 7-seater SUV
stories.summary: Hyundai is developing a three-row premium SUV codenamed Ni1i, expected to launch in late 2027. The vehicle will feature a petrol-hybrid powertrain and be positioned above the Alcazar. A camouflaged test unit was recently spotted with an HEV badge.

stories.title: Five compact SUVs launching soon
stories.summary: Several manufacturers are expanding their SUV lineups in India. Honda will unveil its first electric SUV, the ALPHA, on December 2, with deliveries expected later in 2027. The sub-4-metre and mid-size SUV segments remain among the fastest-growing areas of the Indian market.

stories.title: Maruti & Hyundai To Launch New 7-Seater Electric MPVs in India - India Car News
Toyota to launch three new SUVs
stories.summary: Toyota plans to launch three new SUVs in India next year. The new-generation Fortuner is scheduled for a global debut on December 1, 2026, in South Africa. The company aims to capitalize on the increasing demand for SUVs in the Indian market.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki prepares four new SUVs
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki is planning to launch four new SUVs, including a seven-seater model and an electric crossover. The Fronx facelift is expected in early 2027. A camouflaged test mule of the updated crossover has been spotted on Indian roads.

stories.title: Hyundai’s Two Upcoming 7-Seater Cars For India Explained - Gaadiwaadi.com
Two-wheeler sales rise during festive season
stories.summary: The Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations reported 43.13 lakh two-wheeler retail sales during the 42-day festive period, a 3.67 percent increase over last year. The segment grew 26.02 percent over the last two years. Festive demand remains a reliable metric for the industry.

stories.title: Vietnam sees one in three new bikes go electric
stories.summary: One in three new two-wheelers sold in Vietnam this year is electric. The country is becoming a testing ground for future transportation. In Ho Chi Minh City, families have begun selling electricity, showers, and beds to waiting riders.

stories.title: In Vietnam, an Electric Vehicle Revolution Without Cars - The New York Times
Bajaj Pulsar 125 Neon returns with older parts
stories.summary: Bajaj is bringing back the Pulsar 125 Neon, positioning it below the newer Pulsar 125 launched earlier this year. The model features an older chassis and twin-shock rear suspension. It is expected to be sold alongside the newer version at a lower price point.

stories.title: Triumph Bonneville T40 arrives in India
stories.summary: Triumph has introduced its single-cylinder Bonneville T40 to the Indian market. The manufacturer claims the bike carries a legendary name and fresh character. The company has a history of its motorcycles appearing in films, often sharing the screen with charismatic actors.

stories.title: Triumph Bonneville T40 priced at Rs 2.80 lakh
stories.summary: Triumph has launched the single-cylinder Bonneville T40, which the company describes as the most desirable of its current single-cylinder lineup. The motorcycle features a traditional design intended to mimic its larger siblings. It carries a premium price tag of Rs 2.80 lakh.

stories.title: Bajaj updates Pulsar RS200 for 2026
stories.summary: Bajaj has updated the Pulsar RS200 with a new TFT console and USB charging. The 199.5cc engine now produces 25.1bhp, an increase of 1bhp. The motorcycle is priced at Rs 1.98 lakh. This represents the most significant overhaul since the model's original launch.

stories.title: ISRL rider auction exceeds Rs 4.5 crore
stories.summary: The Indian Supercross Racing League completed its Season 3 rider auction in Pune, with franchises spending over Rs 4.5 crore to sign 42 riders. Australian racer Luke Clout secured the highest bid at Rs 21.46 lakh. The league set a new spending record.

Europe EV share hits 31% in October as Skoda Elroq edges Tesla Model Y - Automotive News
EV retail sales cross 5 lakh mark
stories.summary: India's electric vehicle retail sales reached 5,09,667 units during the 42-day festive season, a 52.62 percent increase over the previous year. This marks the first time EV sales have crossed the five-lakh threshold during a single festive period, according to FADA data.

stories.title: Passenger vehicle sales fall 7% during festive season, EV retail jumps 52.62%: FADA - NewsDrum
Passenger vehicle sales decline as EVs surge
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle sales in India fell 7 percent during the 2026 festive season, while electric vehicle sales increased 52 percent. FADA data suggests that while conventional demand remains subdued, electric mobility continues to capture a larger share of the automobile retail market.

stories.title: Festive vehicle retail shows mixed results
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle retail in India declined 7.16 percent during the 2026 festive season, while electric vehicle sales grew 52.62 percent. Overall vehicle retail reached 55,25,490 units, a 2.21 percent increase compared to the same period last year, according to FADA.

stories.title: India festive vehicle sales decline
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle retail in India fell 7.16 percent during the 2026 festive season, while electric vehicle sales rose 52.62 percent. Total vehicle retail reached 55,25,490 units, a 2.21 percent increase over the previous year. Electric demand has reached a new record.

stories.title: Driving the MG4 EV Urban in Sydney
stories.summary: The MG4 EV Urban Essence 54kWh is marketed as a practical, comfortable, and clever everyday city car. The vehicle features all-electric technology and a compact design. It is intended to be both functional for daily life and fun to drive.

stories.title: European electric vehicle sales rise 60.9 percent
stories.summary: Electric vehicle registrations in Europe reached 295,252 in October, a 60.9 percent increase compared to the same month last year. Automakers are facing increased competition from Chinese brands offering budget models as electric vehicles move into the mass-market segment.

stories.title: Global plug-in car sales reach 25 percent
stories.summary: A new International Energy Agency report states that plug-in cars accounted for 25 percent of global vehicle sales last year, with over 20 million units sold. While the U.S. market stagnates, the report suggests the rest of the world is charging ahead.

stories.title: GEODIS orders 110 heavy-duty electric trucks
stories.summary: GEODIS has ordered 110 battery-electric 44-tonne trucks from Renault and Volvo for its European fleet. The delivery, scheduled for May 2027, will bring the company's total electric vehicle count to 190. The order is intended to scale up zero-tailpipe-emission capacity for urban and long-haul freight transport.

stories.title: Montra Electric reaches 1,000-truck milestone
stories.summary: Montra Electric has produced its 1,000th Rhino heavy-duty electric truck in Haryana. The company claims these vehicles have covered 36 million km and saved 6.5 million kg of CO2, which it equates to the annual carbon absorption of 14 lakh trees. The trucks also reportedly generated running cost savings.

stories.title: Hyundai prepares all-electric Porter truck
stories.summary: Hyundai is developing an all-electric version of its Porter commercial vehicle. The new model features a flatbed platform designed for bulky goods transport and follows the legacy of the original Porter, which served as a workhorse in Asian markets for 22 years. It resembles the Piaggio Porter model.

stories.title: HPH Trust launches Hong Kong’s first autonomous truck fleet at container terminal - ET Auto
Ashok Leyland revenue rises to 9,634 crore
stories.summary: Ashok Leyland reported a Q1FY27 net profit of 609 crore, a 3% increase, with revenue growing 10.4% to 9,634 crore. While domestic volumes rose, EBITDA margins contracted to 10.06% from 11.11% due to higher material costs. Management expects commodity price pressures to persist through the second quarter.

stories.title: Commercial fleet EV adoption faces financing hurdles
stories.summary: Electric vehicle registrations in the truck-and-bus category reached 4,904 in October, a 161% increase from the previous year. Despite this growth, electric models account for only 4.1% of all trucks and buses. Financing remains a primary obstacle for operators despite the urgency of shifting away from fossil fuels.

stories.title: Blazing a trail: UK's first electric-hybrid fire engine completes London trial - BusinessGreen
Electric-hybrid fire engine completes London trial
stories.summary: London Fire Brigade has integrated its first electric-hybrid fire engine into its frontline fleet after a year-long trial. The vehicle attended over 1,500 incidents, including a major warehouse fire, operating on battery power for every call. The appliance was developed in partnership with Emergency One and Babcock Critical Services.

stories.title: Luton airport adds electric ground vehicles
stories.summary: London Luton Airport has introduced new electric vehicles for baggage, towing, and passenger transport to reduce noise and emissions. Ground operations account for less than 1% of the airport's total carbon emissions, with flights producing 1.3 million tonnes compared to 4,722 tonnes from ground equipment in 2025.

stories.title: MLA Rohit Pawar announces tractor rally
stories.summary: NCP (SP) MLA Rohit Pawar will lead a tractor rally starting December 4 to demand a financial package for drought-affected farmers. The rally will travel through six districts before reaching Nagpur on December 9. Pawar stated the event is organized under Sharad Pawar's guidance and is not political.

stories.title: Three killed in tractor-trolley accident in Sagar
stories.summary: Three people died and 33 were injured after a tractor-trolley carrying 36 pilgrims overturned on National Highway-44 in Madhya Pradesh. The group was returning from a religious trip when the vehicle crashed near Neem Ghati. Several passengers were trapped under the trolley following the impact.

stories.title: Three killed in tractor-trolley accident in Sagar
stories.summary: Three people died and 33 were injured after a tractor-trolley carrying 36 villagers overturned on National Highway-44 in Sagar district. The victims were returning from a religious trip to Barman. Local authorities confirmed the identities of the deceased as Raksha Prajapati, Premrani Yadav, and Rakesh Yadav.

stories.title: Tractor-trolley overturns at Neem Ghati in Sagar killing 3 - NewsBytes
Michelin India opens new retail store in Pune
stories.summary: Michelin India has opened a 3,500 sq ft retail outlet in Viman Nagar, Pune, in partnership with Tyre Trax. The store offers passenger tyre sales, fitting, and maintenance services. This expansion is part of the company's effort to grow its retail network and provide technical diagnostic support.

Melexis launches fourth-generation motor drivers
stories.summary: Melexis has introduced its fourth-generation automotive LIN motor drivers, the MLX81352 and MLX81354. The devices are designed for higher-power mechatronic applications, such as thermal management valves and seat fans, offering 1A motor drive capability. The company claims these drivers provide precision control at a lower price point.

LG Electronics wins award for windshield display
stories.summary: LG Electronics won the 2026 Automotive News PACE Pilot Award for its UltraView Windshield Display. The company says the solution presents driving information and infotainment content across a large area of the windshield, reducing the need for drivers to shift their gaze. The windshield is now a screen.

stories.title: LG Electronics wins award for windshield display
stories.summary: LG Electronics won the 2026 Automotive News PACE Pilot Award for its UltraView Windshield Display. The solution adjusts screen size and information density to suit driving conditions. It combines a focus-free augmented reality head-up display with the company's proprietary Hover HUD to show information at different virtual distances.

stories.title: Bonded abrasives market sees steady demand
stories.summary: The global bonded abrasives market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and a more regionally diversified supply architecture. The market is characterized by steady, mature demand underpinned by global industrial output, while undergoing a transformation driven by technological innovation. Shaping materials remains a fundamental task for the industry.

stories.title: EV architectures reshape noise and vibration market
stories.summary: The global market for automotive noise, vibration and harshness systems is entering a structural redefinition. Electrification and software-defined vehicle architectures are dismantling traditional acoustic benchmarks. The removal of the internal combustion engine has eliminated a primary masking noise source while exposing secondary noises such as e-motor whine.

stories.title: Passenger vehicle retail sales decline during festive season
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle retail sales in India declined 7.16 percent to 748,616 units during the 42-day festive season, according to FADA. Overall automobile sales reached a record 5.525 million units, growing 2.21 percent. Volumes remain higher than the period before the current GST rate structure was implemented.

stories.title: Record festive auto sales mask 7.16 per cent slide in passenger vehicle retail - Telegraph India
Passenger vehicle retail sales decline during festive season
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle retail sales in India fell 7.16 percent to 748,616 units during the 42-day festive season, according to FADA. Overall automobile sales reached a record 5.525 million units, a 2.21 percent increase. Sales volumes remain higher than the period before the GST rate rationalization.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki increases car prices
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki has increased prices on select car models by 0.31 percent effective November 22. The company cites sustained cost pressures as the reason for the latest revision. This follows three previous price hikes implemented by the manufacturer over the last three months.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki increases car prices
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki has increased prices on select models by 0.31 percent, effective November 22. The company says the hike is due to sustained cost pressures. This update follows three previous price increases by the manufacturer in the last three months. The company has yet to detail specific model changes.

stories.title: Toyota delists base Hyryder variant
stories.summary: Toyota Kirloskar Motor has removed the entry-level E variant of the Urban Cruiser Hyryder SUV from its lineup. The variant was previously priced at 1.131 million rupees. The SUV's starting price has now risen to 1.282 million rupees. The base model was available only in petrol manual.

stories.title: Toyota Hyryder starting price increases
stories.summary: Toyota has discontinued the entry-level E trim of the Urban Cruiser Hyryder, raising the starting price of the SUV to 1.282 million rupees. The model is now available in four trim levels ranging up to 1.999 million rupees. Dual-tone color variants cost an additional 14,500 rupees.

stories.title: Hyundai India plans to train 15,000 dealer manpower in CY17 - ET Auto
Toyota invests in hybrid manufacturing
stories.summary: Toyota Kirloskar Auto Parts is investing 460 crore rupees to establish a new e-drive manufacturing line at its Bidadi facility. The expansion will increase Toyota's total installed hybrid manufacturing capacity to 360,000 units. The company aims to reduce its dependence on imported components for its hybrid vehicles.

stories.title: Global metal prices face pressure
stories.summary: Copper and zinc prices have weakened due to macroeconomic pressure, softer industrial demand, and rising inventories. A stronger US dollar and higher bond yields have weighed on sentiment. China's industrial production growth missed expectations in October, and crude steel output fell 1.6 percent year-on-year.

stories.title: JSW and Volkswagen discuss joint venture
stories.summary: Negotiations between JSW Group and Volkswagen regarding a potential automotive joint venture in India have stalled over management control. JSW is seeking a 51 percent stake, while Volkswagen prefers a jointly controlled structure. The parties are also debating whether to include certain Skoda models in the partnership.

stories.title: EV industry growth continues
stories.summary: India's electric vehicle industry is expanding as demand for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, and commercial vehicles increases. Companies are focusing on product portfolios and operational strength to benefit from the shift toward electric mobility. Investors are currently reviewing second-quarter results to assess revenue and profitability trends.

Advance Auto Parts and Etsy compared for 2027
stories.summary: Advance Auto Parts and Etsy are being weighed as investment options for 2027. Advance Auto Parts relies on brick and mortar repair demand, while Etsy operates a digital marketplace for independent entrepreneurs. The two companies take opposite paths to growth, which is one way to put it.

stories.title: Ford and General Motors outlook for 2027
stories.summary: Ford is using its commercial division to maintain cash flow during its electric vehicle transition, while General Motors relies on higher profitability from traditional combustion engines. The two automakers are currently balancing value and growth potential as the industry shifts. The transition remains a test of resilience.

NX Automotive Logistics deploys autonomous vehicle in China
stories.summary: NX Automotive Logistics has launched an electric autonomous vehicle at its Foshan facility to shuttle parts between a warehouse and a manufacturing plant. The company says the move streamlines just in time replenishment and reduces emissions. The vehicle covers a 3 kilometre corridor between the two sites.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz wins first German point-to-point approval - Automotive World
Mercedes-Benz expands point to point driver assistance
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz is launching its MB.Drive Assist Pro system in the United States, starting with an early access program in California this December. The system is classified as SAE Level 2++ and handles steering and braking through urban intersections. It is a hands off system that requires eyes on.

stories.title: Partly releases automotive repair reasoning model
stories.summary: Partly has launched Interpreter 3, a reasoning model trained on six years of repair data and 50 brands of OEM catalogs. The company claims the model outperformed six general purpose frontier models in November 2026 benchmarks. The model is designed specifically for automotive repair reasoning.

stories.title: Qualcomm and VinFast discuss future of driver assistance
stories.summary: Leaders from Qualcomm and the automotive industry met at the V-Creator All Star Summit in Vietnam to discuss the future of mobility. The event focused on how AI powered tools like lane centering and hazard detection are becoming standard. Technology is steadily changing what everyday driving looks like.

stories.title: Machina Labs launches Rebellis brand for vehicle customization
stories.summary: Machina Labs has launched Machina Rebellis to produce customized metal body panels using AI and robotics. The company says the technology avoids the costs of traditional stamping dies and dedicated tooling. It aims to help manufacturers produce low volume models without lengthy lead times for custom parts.

stories.title: Qualcomm automotive chip revenue reaches $8 billion
stories.summary: Qualcomm has reached $8 billion in annual revenue from its automotive chip division. The company expects to overtake rivals Infineon and NXP to become the world's largest automotive semiconductor supplier in 2027. The diversification away from volatile smartphone demand is reportedly paying off ahead of schedule.

Chandigarh scrapping of old vehicles picks up pace, but numbers still low - ET Auto
Auto policy debate continues
stories.summary: A new auto policy aims to benefit consumers and assemblers, though critics argue it risks undermining local parts manufacturing and the domestic engineering industry. Discussions regarding the policy are currently underway between the federal board of revenue and the International Monetary Fund. The policy is in final stages.

stories.title: Egypt targets automotive manufacturing hub status
stories.summary: Egypt is seeking to expand local manufacturing and component production to become a regional export hub. Minister of Industry Khaled Hashem stated the sector is a priority for attracting investment and integrating into global supply chains. The government aims to move beyond simple vehicle assembly.

stories.title: Egypt hosts automotive summit for industry development
stories.summary: Minister of Industry Khaled Hashem chaired the 11th Egypt Automotive Summit to discuss developing the automotive and feeder industries. The government aims to establish an integrated manufacturing base that includes component localization. The event included global and local manufacturers, component suppliers and various other industry stakeholders.

Philippines seeks Chinese investment for domestic EV industry
stories.summary: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. met with BYD CEO Wang Chuanfu to discuss expanding the domestic electric vehicle industry. The talks focused on aligning the nation with global sustainable transport shifts, aiming to improve Clean Air Act compliance and create new employment opportunities through increased EV adoption.

stories.title: BYD plans to expand Indonesian investment by 2027
stories.summary: BYD intends to increase its investment in Indonesia by 2027, targeting charging infrastructure, local component manufacturing, and battery production facilities. The company aims to establish the country as a primary production base for electrified vehicles in Southeast Asia, according to a company representative.

stories.title: Mahindra Racing partners with Valeo for Formula E GEN4
stories.summary: Mahindra Racing has appointed Valeo as its official performance and engineering partner for the upcoming Formula E GEN4 programme. The collaboration will focus on developing motor-control software and hardware to improve powertrain performance. Valeo already supplies eAxle technology for Mahindra production vehicles.

stories.title: F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026 schedule
stories.summary: The 2026 Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix is scheduled for 21 November at the Las Vegas Strip Circuit. The 50-lap race begins at 8 PM local time. For viewers in India, the event starts at 9:30 AM on Sunday, 22 November.

stories.title: Qatar Grand Prix 2026 dates and viewing information
stories.summary: Formula 1 returns to the Lusail International Circuit for the Qatar Grand Prix from 27 to 29 November 2026. The race is scheduled for Sunday at 7:00 PM local time. The event will follow a conventional weekend format with no sprint race scheduled.

stories.title: Formula E testing halted after car fire
stories.summary: British driver Taylor Barnard escaped his car after it caught fire and exploded during pre-season testing at Jarama, Spain. The incident forced an early end to the session. Formula E confirmed that no injuries occurred, and the cause of the fire remains under investigation.

stories.title: Parker Retzlaff records 27 top-15 finishes in 2026
stories.summary: Parker Retzlaff and his No. 99 team achieved 27 top-15 finishes across 33 races in the NASCAR O’Reilly Auto Parts Series this year. The 23-year-old driver, who earned his first playoff appearance, attributed the performance to a consistent strategy of finishing every race.

stories.title: China introduces stricter EV battery recycling rules
stories.summary: China is implementing new guidelines requiring electric vehicles and their batteries to be scrapped together alongside a digital tracking system. National research centers estimate 300,000 tonnes of batteries will retire in 2026, with volumes expected to exceed 2 million tonnes annually by 2030.

stories.title: China updates EV battery recycling and tracking standards
stories.summary: China has issued new guidelines to manage the surge of retired electric vehicle batteries, mandating that vehicles and batteries be scrapped together. The government aims to establish a digital tracking system and turn domestic recycling standards into international benchmarks as annual retirement volumes reach millions of tonnes.

stories.title: Industry group launches campaign to protect EV tax discount
stories.summary: The National Automotive Leasing and Salary Packaging Association has launched a national advertising campaign to encourage government support for Australia's Electric Car Discount. The campaign, which includes television and social media spots, projects millions of views to highlight the incentive's benefits for consumers.

stories.title: Electric Vehicle Council urges passage of discount legislation
stories.summary: The Electric Vehicle Council is calling on Parliament to pass changes to the Electric Car Discount announced in the May Budget. CEO Julie Delvecchio stated the package is necessary to keep electric vehicles affordable for families and protect them from volatile global oil prices.

stories.title: Honda fuel cell module achieves high stationary efficiency
stories.summary: A Honda automotive fuel cell module reached a peak energy efficiency of 97.1 percent when tested as a stationary combined heat and power system. Researchers evaluated the 78-kilowatt unit on a specialized test bench without modifying its physical components, according to the Journal of Power Sources Advances.

stories.title: EVs displaced 2.3 million barrels of oil daily in 2025
stories.summary: Electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles displaced 2.3 million barrels of oil consumption per day in 2025, according to BloombergNEF. The research firm projects this figure will more than double by the end of the decade as global sales of battery-powered vehicles continue to climb.

stories.title: Toyota leads Philippine sales as VinFast gains ground
stories.summary: Toyota Motor Philippines maintained its market lead in October with 20,232 units sold, representing over 54 percent of the total reported by industry groups. Vietnamese automaker VinFast emerged as the top seller of battery-electric vehicles among the brands tracked in the latest sales report.

stories.title: SAIC reaches one million sales as MG grows in New Zealand
stories.summary: SAIC Motor reported over one million passenger vehicle sales for 2026. In New Zealand, the MG brand recorded 4,450 registrations through October, a 27 percent increase over the same period in 2025. MG is currently the fifth-largest passenger vehicle brand in the country.

stories.title: Regional Australians show high demand for EVs via novated leases
stories.summary: BYD reported that regional Australians are significant users of novated leases for electric vehicle purchases. In areas like Rockhampton, nearly 60 percent of Sealion 7 purchases were made through these leases. The company highlighted the data to emphasize the importance of the federal Electric Car Discount.

Volkswagen seeks two-year pay freeze in IG Metall talks - Automotive World
Chinese car market share surpasses Japanese brands in 39 countries
stories.summary: Chinese automakers have surpassed Japanese manufacturers in new car market share across 39 of 93 countries surveyed by Mobility Insight. The shift is attributed to rising global oil prices, which have boosted sales of electric vehicles where Chinese companies hold a competitive edge. The market is adjusting.

stories.title: China-made cars push Korea auto trade deficit to record high
stories.summary: South Korea’s auto trade deficit with China reached 4.23 billion dollars in the first ten months of the year, a 92.7 percent increase. Tesla models from Shanghai and various Chinese brands are driving the import growth. Domestic manufacturers are finding the competition to be quite literal.

stories.title: South Korea auto deficit with China soars on EV surge
stories.summary: South Korea’s auto trade deficit with China has hit a record 4.2 billion dollars as Chinese electric vehicles gain market share. The surge is threatening the domestic industry as Chinese imports approach 50 percent of the local market. The domestic industry is currently evaluating its options.

Toyota CEO warns suppliers of industry survival battle
stories.summary: Toyota CEO Koji Sato told suppliers that the automotive industry is battling for survival, citing a need to loosen production standards and reduce costs. Toyota has historically maintained a strategy of lean production and low risk. The strategy that worked until now is being reconsidered.
